subject: Hosted API pricing qualification: expected monthly token volume + peak TPS
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API pricing qualification: token volumes + TPS - follow up

Alex — great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and a couple of clarifying questions to land a clean hosted pricing estimate: 

Recap / what I heard:
- Primary use: product search + summarization for customer support flows.
- Expected workload shape: steady background embedding/indexing plus interactive generation for web UI.
- Latency SLO: p95 < 400ms for UI flows.

Questions for pricing qualification (helps us propose a realistic unit price):
1) Expected monthly token consumption (best estimate or low/likely/high).
2) Peak TPS (concurrent requests at busiest minute).
3) Budget range or target $/1M tokens you’re aiming for (helps set the right tier/discounts).

From our side, to give you a sense of scale: for hosted API customers, unit economics and recommended tiering change materially at ~10M, 50M, and 200M tokens/month. If you can share a ballpark monthly count and peak TPS we’ll return a tailored pricing sheet (I’ve attached a baseline pricing sheet for reference).

Next steps: if you can reply with numbers, I’ll loop in Dylan (SE) to size the perf test and draft a 30-day pilot quote.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-hosted-pricing-2026.pdf

From: Alex Johnson <alex@acmeretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification: token volumes + TPS - follow up

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap and the pricing sheet. Confirming numbers from our side (estimates based on current roadmap):

- Expected monthly token volume: ~120,000,000 tokens/month (peak quarter could be ~150M).
- Peak TPS: around 12 TPS for the interactive UI flows (we expect most traffic to be steady with the occasional spike from flash sales).
- Budget range: we're targeting roughly $8,000–$10,000/month initially for hosted inference; open to pilot pricing and committed discounts if unit economics make sense.

A couple more notes: we plan to use a mixed model strategy — smaller cheaper base model for high-frequency summarization and a higher-quality variant for marquee flows. Latency is important but we can tolerate up to 500ms p95 on the heavier model.

I attached a simple token-breakdown that maps our current features to estimated token usage per surface. Happy to hop on a 20–30m follow-up with Dylan to go over perf and the pilot plan.

Best,
Alex Johnson
Head of Product Engineering, Acme Retail
alex@acmeretail.com
Attachment: acme-token-breakdown.xlsx

Alex — perfect, this is exactly what we need. Thanks for the fast turnaround. 

Proposed next steps from Redwood: 
- I'll put together a hosted pilot quote aligned to 120M tokens/month with two unit tiers (base & high-quality). Early estimate (ballpark) — assuming the mix you described: target unit economics ~ $65 / 1M tokens blended for the pilot. Final quote will be model-dependent.
- Dylan: can we schedule a 30-min perf run for next week to validate p95 and confirm infra footprint for sustained 12 TPS + 2x headroom?
- We'll include an optional 30-day pilot agreement with a commit for discounted pricing and a simple rollback policy.

Questions for you: preferred billing cadence (monthly vs quarterly)? Also, do you have any compliance checkbox items we should include in the pilot (SOC 2 focused)?

I’ll attach a tailored quote and an abbreviated pilot MSA once Dylan confirms the perf sizing.
